capabilities: Search full text inside PDFs, EPUBs and Office files
Open results at the matching page
Jump to the reference note that links a document
Warm the extraction cache for fast later searches
Search PowerPoint, Excel and Keynote files via adapters
disambiguation: Not a replacement for Obsidian's note search; it only searches inside PDF, EPUB and Office documents, leaving Markdown notes to Obsidian.
extras: Desktop only; the ripgrep-all CLI must be installed separately. Extracted text is cached outside the vault, and the first pass over a large library can take over an hour; scanned PDFs without a text layer cannot be searched.
problem: Obsidian's own search covers Markdown notes but not the text inside PDFs, EPUBs and Office documents stored in the vault.

relations.evidence: Stacks files each PDF in your vault and links it from its reference note's pdf property.

summary: Full-text search inside PDFs, EPUBs and Office files in your vault, powered by ripgrep-all, with page-level results.
